finalText:
**It's a small Node service in five files, no dependencies and no tests.**

```mermaid
graph LR
  server.js --> auth.js
  server.js --> routes.js
  routes.js --> cache.js
  routes.js --> store.js
```

`server.js` checks the token on every request, then hands off. `auth.js` reads a bearer token shaped `userId.signature` and checks the signature. `routes.js` maps `GET /users`, `GET /orders`, and `POST /orders` to handlers. Reads go through `cache.js`, a 256-entry cache with no expiry. `store.js` is an in-memory map where records die 15 minutes after a write.

One thing to know: `routes.js` says writes clear the cached keys, but nothing does. A new order won't show up in `GET /orders` until the cache entry is pushed out.
